77880.meaning1: would have greatly benefited; would have profited enormously; (comm) would have attained the fruit of stream entry
77880.meaningLit: would have been joined with great benefit
77880.commentary: (MNa) mahatā atthena saṃyutto agamissā'ti mahatā atthena saṃyutto hutvā gato bhaveyya, sot'āpattiphalaṃ pāpuṇeyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, pesso hatth'ārohaputto muhuttaṃ nisīdeyya yāvass'āhaṃ ime cattāro puggale vitthārena vibhajissāmi, mahatā atthena saṃyutto abhavissa.
tena hi, samma kappaka, tāni palitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā mama añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpehī'ti.

77882.meaning1: (of fire) to light; to set alight

examples.text: na sakkonti āḷimpetun'ti aṭṭha'pi soḷasa'pi dvattiṃsa'pi janā jālan'atthāya yamaka-yamaka-ukkāyo gahetvā tālavaṇṭehi bījantā bhastāhi dhamantā tāni tāni kāraṇāni karontā'pi na sakkonti'y'eva aggiṃ gāhāpetuṃ.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idha khattiyakumāro brāhmaṇakaññāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya, tesaṃ saṃvāsam'anvāya putto jāyetha, yo so khattiyakumārena brāhmaṇakaññāya putto uppanno, siyā so mātu'pi sadiso pitu'pi sadiso, khattiyo'ti'pi vattabbo brāhmaṇo'ti'pi vattabbo'ti?
ye keci atthi samaṇā pathabyā, kāsāyavatthā anagāriyā te, pāto'va piṇḍāya caranti kāle, vikālacariyā viratā hi santo.

77885.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ima

examples.text: na mayaṃ ito bhiyyo uttaritaraṃ pajānāmā'ti.

77886.meaning1: more than this; better than this; greater than this; superior to this
77886.commentary: (DNa) ito bhiyyo uttaritaran'ti ito dibbacakkhuñāṇ'ādhigamato bhiyyo aññaṃ uttaritaraṃ vises'ādhigamaṃ mayaṃ sutivasen'āpi na jānāmā'ti vadanti.

examples.text: na mayaṃ ito bhiyyo uttaritaraṃ pajānāmā'ti.
[sāviyogā ettha sācisaddo kuṭilapariyāyo]

77890.meaning1: noble vision; insight of an awakened being

examples.text: tañ'hi te, māgaṇḍiya, ariyaṃ cakkhuṃ n'atthi yena tvaṃ ariyena cakkhunā ārogyaṃ jāneyyāsi, nibbānaṃ passeyyāsī'ti. evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhoto gotamassa!

imissā ca, bhikkhave, mahāpathaviyā pahūtarattaratanāya [pahūtasattaratanāya tikanipāte mahāvagge dasamasuttaṭīkāyaṃ dassitapāḷiyā sameti] mātāpitaro issar'ādhipacce rajje patiṭṭhāpeyya, na tv'eva, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ kataṃ vā hoti paṭikataṃ vā.

77892.meaning1: but some days I even; sometimes I too; on some occasions I also

examples.text: app'ekad'āhaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, iddhimā'va maññe na attano balena samasamaṃ samanupassāmī'ti.
app'ekad'āhaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, idha pādaṃ karissāmī'ti aññen'eva pādaṃ karomī'ti.

77894.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of añña
77894.meaning1: elsewhere; somewhere else; in another place

examples.text: eta'r'ahi jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto āsītiko me vayo vattati. app'ekad'āhaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, idha pādaṃ karissāmī'ti aññen'eva pādaṃ karomī'ti.

tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya, ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabb'ākārasampanno, tatr'idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā'ti.

77896.meaning1: having pointed their feet towards me; having positioned their feet in my direction
77896.meaningLit: having made me from the feet

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, ime isidattapurāṇā thapatayo bahu'd'eva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya vītināmetvā, yato ahosi bhagavā tato sīsaṃ katvā maṃ pādato karitvā nipajjiṃsu.
uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, vīriyaṃ ārabhati, cittaṃ paggaṇhāti, padahati.

77899.meaning1: sense of rulership; meaning of governorship
77899.commentary: (ANt) ind'aṭṭhaṃ kāretī'ti anuvattanavasena sampayuttadhammesu ind'aṭṭhaṃ kāreti, tasmā ādhipateyy'aṭṭhena saddhā eva indriyan'ti saddh'indriyaṃ.
